# Vantum Intelligence

> Client acquisition systems for remodelers and home-service businesses.

Vantum Intelligence is a strategy, marketing, and implementation firm founded in 2025. It works remotely with owner-operated remodeling and home-service companies across the United States, typically those doing $1 million or more a year with two or more crews.

The firm builds client acquisition systems: it diagnoses which stretch of a company's path from first click to signed contract is losing work, then rebuilds that stretch. It delivers five connected services — strategy and planning, advertising and creative, websites and landing pages, search and AI visibility (SEO and AEO), and automation and follow-up — and carries out the work directly rather than handing strategy to separate vendors for implementation.

What separates it from a lead service is sequence. A lead service is paid the moment it hands over a name, so nothing it earns depends on what happens next, and the same name is often sold to more than one company. Vantum Intelligence runs campaigns too, but the inquiries belong to the client and are never resold, and volume is not turned up until the follow-up, the landing page, and the search presence can carry it.

Engagements open with a free 30-minute path review on a screen share, which walks the company's own path and names what to fix first. Retainers run $2,500, $4,000, or $6,500+ per month with a 3-month minimum, plus a one-time setup fee of $2,000–$5,000. Ad spend is separate and paid from client-owned ad accounts. Results are reported against booked calls and signed work rather than impressions.

Contact: contact@vantumintelligence.com
